necessary_context.content: E is a finite-dimensional Euclidean space equipped with an arbitrary norm and its dual. Z is nonempty compact convex. F:Z→E is bounded and monotone. Err_vi(z)=max_{u∈Z}<F(u),z-u>. For all z,z'∈Z, ||F(z)-F(z')||_*≤L||z-z'||+M, L,M≥0.
necessary_context.locator: PDF pp.1–2 equations (1)–(5); p.6 opening of §3
necessary_context.name: Weak VI gap and operator model

necessary_context.content: ω:Z→R is continuous convex. On Z°={z∈Z:∂ω(z) is nonempty}, it admits a continuous selection ω'(z)∈∂ω(z) satisfying <ω'(z)-ω'(z'),z-z'>≥||z-z'||² for all z,z'∈Z°. Set V(z,u)=ω(u)-ω(z)-<ω'(z),u-z>, Θ(z)=max_{u∈Z}V(z,u), zc=argmin_Z ω, Ω=√(2Θ(zc)), and P_z(ξ)=argmin_{u∈Z}{V(z,u)+<ξ,u>}. The source defines P_z:E→Z°.
necessary_context.locator: PDF pp.6–7 §3.1 equations (14)–(18) and prox definition
necessary_context.name: Distance generator and prox

necessary_context.applies_to: Expected result Theorem 1(i); Assumption II is not required
necessary_context.content: At successive calls the SO uses fresh iid random variables ζ_i and a Borel map Ξ:Z×R^N→E. For every z∈Z, ||E[Ξ(z,ζ_i)-F(z)]||_*≤μ and E||Ξ(z,ζ_i)-F(z)||_*²≤σ². Freshness is relative to the information available before the call; the second query point depends on the first response.
